verdict.rationale: The docs directly show that you can start Devin work by tagging it in a Slack thread. Linear is only implied by "tackle Linear/Jira tickets," with no explicit trigger-from-Linear mechanism. PR-based Auto-Fix responds to code review comments, but the evidence never names GitHub or GitLab as places to start a task. Missing for 10: explicit kickoff from GitHub (e.g., @mention on issues or PRs), any GitLab support, a documented in-Linear trigger mechanism, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: Tag Devin on a Slack or Teams thread about a bug you're discussing with coworkers
Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets
With Auto-Fix enabled, Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
